The user wants to check different options for booking flight with booking id 1234. They want to calculate from the available list's first airport to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024, business class ticket price. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then get the first and last airport codes. Then get flight cost for travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to provide estimated total payable amount. But we also need to consider that the user wants to arrange a flight on booking id 1234. Possibly we need to book flight? The user says "I need to arrange a flight as soon as possible on booking id 1234, and want to check different options." So they might want to book a flight using booking id 1234? Actually booking id 1234 is presumably an existing booking. They want to arrange a flight on that booking id. But the booking id is used for retrieving booking history, cancel booking, etc. For booking a flight, we need booking id? No, book_flight requires card_id, travel_date, travel_from, travel_to, travel_class. It doesn't require booking id. So maybe they want to create a new booking? Or they want to modify an existing booking? There's no function to modify booking. So maybe they want to cancel the existing booking and then book a new one? But the user didn't ask to cancel. They just want to arrange a flight on booking id 1234. That might mean they want to add a flight to that booking? Not sure.

But the question: "計算從可用列表中的第一個機場到同一列表中的最後一個機場，在 2024 年 10 月的最後一天的商務艙票價。請提供我預估的總應付金額。" So they want to compute cost. We can call get_flight_cost. Then we need to provide estimated total payable amount. But we also need to consider that the user might have a credit card. We need to get all credit cards, pick one, get its balance, see if it covers the cost. But the user didn't specify card. So we can just provide the cost. But the user asked for "estimated total payable amount". That might include insurance? They didn't mention insurance. So just the flight cost.

Thus we need to call get_all_airports to get list. Then get_flight_cost. Then provide cost. Let's do that.
